title: Cisco Room Kit Pro G2: Large Room Video Conferencing System
text:
Cisco Room Kit Pro G2: Large Room Video Conferencing System

 No more AV puzzles. Just remarkable meetings. 

## Enter the new era of large-room collaboration.

Bring premium video conferencing to your large and high-impact spaces with the Room Kit Pro G2. Featuring an NVIDIA-powered room engine, intelligent camera options, and smart accessories, it’s the most powerful device solution to enable next-generation AI workflows, scalable AV over IP room orchestration, and enterprise-grade management to simplify your most demanding spaces at scale.

 

Scalable AV over IP

 NVIDIA 

AI processing

 MDEP 

 5K 

### Intelligence, reimagined.

Multi-camera intelligence. Crystal-clear audio. Automatic notetaking. Smart meeting zones. The NVIDIA-powered AI engine provides advanced audiovisual processing and runs the latest agentic workflows to create seamless, high-impact video meetings so your team can be productive whether they're across the table or across the globe.

 

### Remove the distance.

Imagine large rooms, training rooms, boardrooms, and multi-purpose spaces where technology disappears—where every meeting is flawless, content sharing is effortless, and every room works exactly the way you expect. No second-guessing. Just walk in and start your meeting.

 

### No more plug-and-pray.

Gone are the days of multi-vendor external DSPs, messy cabling, adapter jigsaws, and power drop chaos. The Room Kit Pro G2 brings unparalleled Power over Ethernet (PoE) capacity to connect, control, and power your room peripherals while allowing for seamless scaling to support your rooms as they evolve, without costly redesigns or duct-tape fixes.

 

### Your platform is no longer a barrier.

Enjoy flexible, multi-platform video collaboration on Cisco Rooms, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, or Google Meet natively—and join any meeting via BYOD.

 

## One network. Endless possibilities.

Simplify your room ecosystem with AVoIP.

Ceiling Speaker Pro

Ceiling Microphone Pro

Table Microphone Pro

Room Vision PTZ

 Simplify multi-camera intelligence. 

Solve the most advanced multi-camera and multi-purpose room experiences out of the box.

 Divisible rooms 

Simplify your complex divisible multi-purpose spaces without extensive custom programming and costly support services.

### Connect everything.

Room Kit Pro G2 offers the ultimate integrator powerhouse to bring together your IP accessories, tracking cameras, large-format displays, multiple 5K content sources, professional audio systems, USB peripherals, and more. Intelligently elevate your conference rooms, training rooms, executive spaces, and specialist AV environments to support your evolving collaboration use cases and standards.

 Join any meeting, anytime. Explore Video Interoperability 

Collaborate your way—join any meeting at the click of a button with Cisco Rooms, or choose the native Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, or Google Meet experience.

### Supports the way you work.

Don’t settle for a one room, one platform approach. Room Kit Pro G2 is optimized for Webex, supports full-featured Zoom for Cisco Rooms, and can be deployed as a native Microsoft Teams Room. And as the first large-room solution to support the Microsoft Device Ecosystem Platform (MDEP), you can leverage enterprise-grade security, upgrades, and manageability for your MTR deployment.

Regular upgrades allow you to continuously enhance the experience and increase the value of your deployment. Gain proactive oversight with AI-assisted workspace ranking, smart diagnostics, and intelligent workspace connectors.
